author: ex_optic
body:
Hi everyone, Rilo and I have been working on a new map. We need a few pointers and tips on what to build/fix. We also need a title for the map to suggestions are nice too. I will post the album of the map below. There were also a few contributors that Rilo will say when the map is released.

{EDIT}: The map is 2 teams only, and everything is custom, grass, and trees.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/d9DAw#0

Hope you enjoy!

Remember: Suggestions and tips!
